text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you very much for inviting me 
today.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Arima Kinen, I 
suddenly received an invitation from 
Mejiro McQueen to a "special tea party."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san. Your performance at the Arima 
Kinen the other day was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It truly... felt like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It felt as though I were the one who 
won... My heart was truly soaring.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I am deeply honored. To have you think 
so of me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Consider it a small token of my 
gratitudeâ For one who has carved such 
magnificent hoofprints, I have prepared a 
special venue for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Everyone, please come this way.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey! Let's chat lots today, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, gathering together like this feels 
kind of fresh and new, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si! And it makes El and the others feel 
kinda nostalgic too!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: You all are...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's all have fun sharing our fond 
memories of that person~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Her running form, having competed against 
her in so many Grand Prix races... When I 
close my eyes, I can recall it so vividly.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At times, even an Overlord must play the 
narrator. To pay respect to the traveler 
who stood upon my stage longer than any 
other!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'll talk a whole bunch too...! Because 
we've run in so many of the same races 
together...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I am so deeply honored and grateful for 
the chance to speak about Her before you, 
Journey-san! This Digi-tan will give it 
her absolute all!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's grab some snacks and get 
started already. You wanna hear about the 
'Japan Cup', right? I'll tell ya all about 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gasped out loud. That was because every 
single Umamusume gathered here was someone 
who had once raced against Stay Gold—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those who have won GⅠ races like the Tenno 
Sho (Spring), the Takarazuka Kinen, the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), the Japan Cup, and the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This really is... quite a spectacular 
sight—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...It is because of the bonds she has 
forged—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And in all of those fateful races, you 
were there, racking up glorious victories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you agree there couldn't be a more 
perfect day for us to gather?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...Truly."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Everyone. Please, take this opportunity to 
share your thoughts with me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"About your race. And about her, who was 
there—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is unforgettable for 
me too. Because running at full stride on 
that GⅠ stage felt so exhilarating—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I remember well how fiercely we contested 
right down to the wire in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)! It was such a sharp, brilliant 
run..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. For me as well, that powerful 
presence coming from behind... is 
something I just can't forget~."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
She always closes in looking like she's 
having fun. That was... truly terrifying 
in its own right.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, dat is so super cool, yes! Just 
like a luchadora gleefully taking on every 
move!”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—It is safe to say she witnessed the 
entire legend of the End-of-Century 
Overlord.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
After all, you have witnessed both my path 
of conquest and the heroes who struck me 
down!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right. Even though Opera O-san 
was so strong, I remember that you were 
still smiling~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Truly a magnificent traveler, a legend who 
witnessed gold! With hoofprints tracing 
the history of so many Umamusume, Digitan 
is overjoyed to be a part of—CHARACTER 
LIMIT—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, she really is incredible. 
Heading to Hong Kong right after the Japan 
Cup?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Running down a long road and seizing the 
crown at the very, very end. ...That's not 
something just anyone can pull off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The figure of Stay Gold that they spoke of 
was always intertwined with glorious 
races—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone had a somewhat happy smile on 
their faces.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Dream Journey looked happy hearing 
that too... which somehow made me feel 
proud—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —You look happy too.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...The feeling is mutual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The "journey" walked alongside Dream 
Journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It became a tea party that made me glad 
all over again that my journey had been 
adorned with so much glory—"
